pr.title: Fit games to the screen and give each one its own win and loss animation
pr.body:
## Summary
- Move each game into `packages/engines/src/games` and group Docker files under `docker/` and scripts under `scripts/`.
- Keep a match on one screen: the board scales to the space under a compact header, with a per-game mark in the lobby.
- Play a different win animation and a different loss animation for every game (burst, rain, flip, march, spill, and the rest).

## Test plan
- [ ] `bun start`, log in, open Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, and Gomoku and confirm the board fits without scrolling
- [ ] Finish a match as a win and as a loss on two different games and confirm the motions are not the same
- [ ] `bun start:prod` still builds from `docker/compose.prod.yml`

commitMessage:
Restructure games and fit each board to the screen with its own win and loss motion.

One engine file per game, Docker and scripts live in their own folders, and every match plays inside the viewport with a distinct celebration or defeat animation.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
